concept.title: Lives in Shropshire and nearby areas
concept.shortdesc: Services restricted to people living in Shropshire, Telford and Wrekin or other named nearby places and regions, including some military-base dependants.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.75).
Feed-specific: shropshire holds 93% of its records. It may reflect one directory's habits rather than a real category.
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into 'lives in Shropshire, Telford and Wrekin or nearby areas' and 'dependants of staff at a named military base'.

section.p: Identifier in this run: elig-012. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
